# Maverick Danielle Andres — Portfolio

Personal portfolio website of Maverick Danielle Andres, a Full-Stack Web & App Developer based in Pasig City, Philippines.

## About

Maverick is a Full-Stack Developer and Project Lead specializing in scalable web and mobile applications. Core expertise includes React, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase, and AI/automation integrations.
